name: HRC_ALERT_RUN_ERRORS
description: Contains alert run errors for a given run.

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Error Type, possible values are ORA_E (Error),ORA_W (Warning),ORA_I(Info) and ORA_S (System Error)

columns.name: PARENT_RUN_ID
columns.description: Run Identifier of Parent. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERTS_RUNS.RUN_ID

columns.name: RUN_ID
columns.description: Run Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERT_RUNS.RUN_ID

columns.name: ERROR_SOURCE
columns.description: Specifies the source of the error. Valid values are: R=Run,M=Message,R=Recipient

columns.name: ERROR_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Specifies the source identifier and is dependent on the contents of the ERROR_SOURCE. If R (Run) then HRC_ALERT_RUNS.RUN_ID. If M (Message) then HRC_ALERT_RUN_MESSAGES.RUN_MESSAGE_ID. If R (Recipient) then HRC_ALERT_RUN_RECIPIENTS.RECIPIENT_ID.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG_TEXT
columns.description: Details of the error message. As we are using CLOB column, its taking time, instead going forward we can use this column which will have just the details.

columns.name: ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: The error text of the Alert Run Error record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SURROGATE_ID
columns.description: SurrogateId of the record of the rest resource related table that is configured in the Alert.

columns.name: PROP_NAME
columns.description: Property Name of the Alert Run Error record.

columns.name: PROP_VALUE
columns.description: Property Value of the Alert Run Error record.

columns.name: FUNC_NAME
columns.description: Function Name of the Alert Run Error record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME1
columns.description: Function First Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL1
columns.description: Function First Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME2
columns.description: Function Second Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL2
columns.description: Function Second Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_NAME3
columns.description: Function Third Argument Name of the record.

columns.name: FUNC_ARG_VAL3
columns.description: Function Third Argument Value of the record.

columns.name: ERROR_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Error Subtype of the Alert Run Error record.
